Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
The unit must be out of service.

Connect Frequency counter to pin 1 and pin 31 
 from connector card A ( 1L7X )

Install over speed test card furnished with gas 
 turbine in place of the over speed trip card QOXC in 1LOJ. which causes over 
 speed trip alarm appear.

Press and hold (run push button) located on 
 test card to cancel alarm.

Turn master control switch to auto. Position 
 and start the turbine.

Remove hand from ( run push button ) located on 
 test card after 14HR lamp light .

When speed arrive to F.S.N.L. we adjust speed 
 by means of " raise lower " switch to 95 % of rated .

Push and hold over speed test button of SSZB 
 card on 1L1N. turbine speed will ( > 100% & < 110% ) .

Raise speed by means of " raise lower " 
 switch to 112% from the rated speed and check the turbine tripped and alarm 
 over speed appear .

If the turbine not trip at 112% from rated 
 speed. it must be tripped by emergency stop push button before 114% 
 (<5800 RPM).

Adjust mechanical over speed through mechanical 
 maintenance.

Repeat test again from steps ( 1 to 9 ) and 
 record speed when the turbine tripped

Disconnect the frequency counter, the master control switch to off position and check 
 the ratchet system start.

Introduction

 and start the turbine.

 by means of " raise lower " switch to 95 % of rated .
Push and hold over speed test button of SSZB 
 card on 1L1N. turbine speed will ( > 100% & < 110% ) .
Raise speed by means of " raise lower " 
 switch to 112% from the rated speed and check the turbine tripped and alarm 
 over speed appear .
If the turbine not trip at 112% from rated 
 speed. it must be tripped by emergency stop push button before 114% 
 (<5800 RPM).
Adjust mechanical over speed through mechanical 
 maintenance.
Repeat test again from steps ( 1 to 9 ) and 
 record speed when the turbine tripped
Disconnect the frequency counter, the master control switch to off position and check 
 the ratchet system start.
